mapper.insert: insert into member(account, password, name, gender, phone, birthday, bloodType, illnessHistory, allergy) values(#{account}, #{password}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{phone}, #{birthday}, #{bloodType}, #{illnessHistory}, #{allergy})
mapper.update: update member set account=#{account}, name=#{name}, gender=#{gender}, phone=#{phone}, birthday=#{birthday}, bloodType=#{bloodType}, illnessHistory=#{illnessHistory}, allergy=#{allergy} where id = #{id}
